title: On the Duality between Feature and Sample Screening
summary: Feature and sample screening reduce the cost of machine learning by eliminating irrelevant features and noninformative samples, respectively. Although recognized as primal-dual counterparts, their relationship remains informal and model-dependent. Viewing screening and duality as transformations of objective functions, we introduce Fenchel-Rockafellar (FR) representations, a class of convex problems encompassing the Lasso and SVM that is closed under both transformations.
